posts.title: [Known Issue] Unable to Start the Game Due to a Save File Corruption Message
posts.body:
[p][b]Hello, this is the DragonSword : Awakening team.[/b]

We would like to inform you of the following issue identified after Update 1.1.0, along with a temporary workaround.

[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h3]■ Known Issue[/h3][list][*][p]For some players, the following message appears when starting the game, and the game cannot be started
[/p][/*][/list][quote][p]The save file is corrupted, so a backup file is being loaded.
Some content may differ from your previous gameplay.[/p][/quote][p]
[/p][h3]■ Workaround[/h3][olist][*][p]Switch Steam to Offline Mode (Steam Cloud sync OFF)
[/p][/*][*][p]In your Steam Library, right-click DragonSword : Awakening > \[Properties] > \[Installed Files] > \[Browse][/p][/*][*][p]Go to the path below, then right-click the \[9-digit number folder] and compress it into a zip file (backup)
[/p][/*][/olist][code]DS\\Saved\\savegames\\\[9-digit number folder][/code][olist][*][p]Open the \[9-digit number folder] and delete all files ending in [b].bak[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Launch the game
[/p][/*][*][p]After exiting the game normally, switch Steam back to Online (Steam Cloud sync ON)
[/p][/*][/olist][p]
[b]※ Please make sure to create the backup in step 3 (zip compression) before deleting any files.[/b]

[/p][h3]■ Fix Schedule[/h3][list][*][p]We are currently working on a fix and will announce the schedule separately once it is confirmed.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][hr][/hr][p]
We apologize for the inconvenience.
Thank you for your understanding.

— The DragonSword : Awakening Team[/p]

posts.title: [Greetings] Happy Chuseok from the DragonSword Team
posts.body:
[p][b]Hello, this is HOOON from the DragonSword : Awakening team.[/b]

Here in Korea, we are celebrating one of our biggest holidays — [b]Chuseok (추석), the Korean Harvest Festival[/b].

Chuseok is a holiday with deep roots in Korean tradition. After a year of farming, families would gather to give thanks to their ancestors with the freshly harvested grains and fruits.
Today in Korea, family members who live scattered across the country return home to share carefully prepared meals, enjoy long conversations, and honor their ancestors through memorial rites (Charye) and visits to family graves (Seongmyo).

[/p][hr][/hr][p]
The members of Hound13 continue to work every day to refine [b]DragonSword : Awakening[/b], made possible by the overwhelming love you have shown us.

To celebrate Chuseok, we will be [b]taking 4 days off — September 24, 25, and the following weekend[/b] — to spend time with our families.

After this brief break, we will return next week with a [b]preview of the live stream for the October update showcase[/b].

[/p][hr][/hr][p]
In Korea, we share this greeting to reflect the abundance of Chuseok:

[b]"더도 말고, 덜도 말고 한가위만 같아라"[/b]
[i]"May every day of your life be as full and bountiful as Chuseok itself — no more, no less."[/i]

To all the [b]heroes who love and support DragonSword : Awakening[/b], we sincerely hope that your days ahead will be as rich and abundant as Chuseok itself.

Thank you.

— The Members of Hound13[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46066795/913190de4c29194979620ca6a60918e56a04f6ca.png"][/img][/p]

posts.title: [Notice] Retraction of Steam Workshop Support Plan & Mod Policy Announcement
posts.body:
[b]Hello, this is the DragonSword : Awakening team.[/b]

We sincerely apologize for the significant confusion and concern caused by our previous [Advance Notice] Steam Workshop Support Plan & Mod Policy announcement.
We have taken the feedback shared with us since the announcement seriously as a team.

[hr][/hr]

[h3]■ Retraction of Notice and Guidelines[/h3]

[list]
[*]The previously published [b]Mod Guidelines document is retracted and will not be enforced.[/b]
[*]The policies related to the [Advance Notice] announcement [b]have not been enacted and nothing has been applied.[/b]
[/list]

[h3]■ That said, we kindly ask you to observe these two minimum principles[/h3]

[list]
[*]Actions that infringe upon the rights of users who have purchased the game or DLC
[*]Unauthorized use of content that has not yet been officially released
[/list]

[b]※ These are not new regulations, and there are no measures or enforcement plans in place.[/b] We ask that you understand these as requests for the creative environment we build together as a community.

[hr][/hr]

[h3]■ Background of the Announcement[/h3]

Recently, we became aware of a few Mods created in ways that are outside our direct control. To prepare for such unanticipated forms of Mods, we [b]judged it would be appropriate to share standards in advance[/b], which was the background for this announcement.

While the intent was to provide advance guidance, the notice was [b]written in a level of detail and tone more suited to formally enacted regulations[/b], leading to misunderstandings that restrictions were already in effect and causing a chilling effect on community creative activities.

We acknowledge that our preliminary review was insufficient.

[h3]■ Path Forward[/h3]

We will [b]reconsider the direction of Steam Workshop support from the beginning.[/b]

[hr][/hr]

Going forward, when such announcements are necessary, we will make sure to [b]thoroughly review and communicate with the community before sharing them.[/b]
Thank you to everyone who shared their honest feedback.

— The DragonSword : Awakening Team

posts.title: [Retracted][Advance Notice] Steam Workshop Support Plan & Mod Policy
posts.body:
[b]※ This notice has been retracted and will not be enforced.[/b]

Taking the community's feedback seriously, the content of this notice has been [b]fully retracted and nothing has been applied.[/b]
Please refer to the retraction notice below for details.

🔗 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/4570720/view/719039819889509881][b][Notice] Retraction of Steam Workshop Support Plan & Mod Policy Announcement[/b][/url]

[hr][/hr]

[b]Hello, this is the DragonSword : Awakening team.[/b]

To more clearly and safely support community creation activities for DragonSword : Awakening, we have prepared our official [b]Mod Guidelines[/b].

We are currently [b]preparing Steam Workshop support[/b], and the exact opening schedule will be shared through a separate notice.
Once Steam Workshop is officially supported, we will permit the creation and use of various mods that comply with the Mod Guidelines below.

[hr][/hr]

[h3]■ Permitted Mods (Examples)[/h3]
[list]
[*]User-created free character skins
[*]Texture and color changes
[*]Partial character appearance changes such as glasses, capes, and accessories
[*]FOV / UI / QoL improvements
[*]Gameplay mods that increase difficulty or provide new challenges
[/list]

[h3]■ Prohibited Mods (Examples)[/h3]
[list]
[*]Mods that unlock DLC or bypass DLC purchase requirements
[*]Trainers, cheats, and mods that lower difficulty or provide unfair advantages
[*]Content that uses IP from other games or third parties without permission
[*]Content that infringes copyrights, portrait rights, or other third-party rights
[*]Mods that use unreleased, non-public, or otherwise unprovided characters, models, data, or game content
[*]Extraction or redistribution of the game's original sound, video, models, textures, or other assets
[*]Content designed to replicate official paid content or substitute for its purchase
[*]Features that improperly bypass achievements, progression, rewards, or content unlocks
[*]Explicit sexual content
[*]Paid or paywalled mods
[*]Mods that pose security risks to users, such as malware or unauthorized personal data collection
[*]Content that impersonates or is misleadingly presented as official content from Hound13 or DragonSword : Awakening
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h3]■ Clarification of Existing Policy and Response Standards[/h3]

[b]This section does not introduce any new restrictions, and there are no changes to our existing Mod policy or response approach.[/b]

This clarification has been prepared to formally document areas where explicit rules had not yet been laid out, and to prevent any misunderstanding regarding our support and provision scope ahead of Steam Workshop launch.

The following items are being explicitly outlined because they [b]directly affect the game's revenue, or may create a sense of unfairness for users who have purchased DLC[/b]:

[list]
[*]Unauthorized restoration, use, or distribution of non-public, unreleased, or unprovided characters, models, data, Assets, or other game content
[*]Restoring or distributing non-public content identified through data mining so that it becomes usable in-game
[*]Extracting the game's or DLC's original Assets and distributing them as separate files
[*]Bypassing purchase, ownership verification, or access conditions for DLC or other paid content
[*]Creating or distributing tools that bypass, disable, or interfere with game updates, DRM, integrity checks, or other technical protection features
[*]Creating or distributing content infringing upon Hound13's or third parties' copyrights and other intellectual property rights
[/list]

When such content is identified, we may request the creator to cease distribution, or ask the distribution platform to remove the content or restrict access.

This is intended solely to [b]protect the long-term operation of the game and the interests of users who have supported it through their purchases[/b]. It is not intended to restrict or discourage community creative activities.

[hr][/hr]

[h3]⚠️ Regarding Co-op Play[/h3]

Even after Steam Workshop support begins, [b]Co-op will not be available in environments where mods are active or unauthorized modifications to game files are detected.[/b]

[list]
[*]Co-op will only be supported in [b]Vanilla environments[/b] using unmodified game files.
[*]Even permitted Steam Workshop mods will disable Co-op functionality while active.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h3]⚠️ Technical Support for Mod Usage[/h3]

Although Steam Workshop will be provided as the official means to distribute and use mods, [b]Hound13 does not guarantee the proper functioning of individual mods or their compatibility following game updates.[/b]

The following issues caused by mod usage are, in principle, not covered by Hound13's technical support:

[list]
[*]Game crashes
[*]Save data corruption
[*]Performance degradation
[*]Graphics or gameplay errors
[*]Game progression blockage
[*]Conflicts between mods
[*]Mods not functioning properly after game updates
[/list]

If issues occur, please first [b]verify whether the problem reproduces in a clean game environment with all mods disabled or removed.[/b]

[hr][/hr]

[h3]📖 Official Mod Guidelines[/h3]

The complete mod policy and detailed permitted/prohibited criteria can be found in the [b]DragonSword : Awakening Official Mod Guidelines[/b] below.

🔗 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3789181313][Mod Guidelines Link][/url]

[hr][/hr]

[b]※ Please Note[/b]
[list]
[*]Steam Workshop is not yet available at this time.
[*]Mod permission rules related to Steam Workshop will officially take effect once Workshop support begins.
[*]Mods outside of Steam Workshop and third-party modding tools are currently not officially permitted.
[*]Steam Workshop opening schedule and EULA revision enforcement schedule will be shared through separate notices.
[/list]

We will continue to support DragonSword : Awakening's community creation activities over the long term, while preparing an environment that protects the game, its users, and Hound13's rights alike.

Thank you.

— The DragonSword : Awakening Team

Thank you to everyone who joined our [b]All Day Live[/b] broadcast on August 10.
We've compiled all questions received during the 8-hour stream along with answers from Producer JYJ and PM Hooon.

[b]🎬 Watch the Replay[/b][/p][previewyoutube="waZiN2aIOD8;full"][/previewyoutube][p]

※ Items marked with [b]✅[/b] have been addressed in subsequent patches (1.0.7 ~ 1.0.9).

[/p][h3]■ Updates & Roadmap[/h3][p]
[b]Q. When will new story content and raid bosses be added?[/b]
A. The main story and new raid bosses take considerable time to develop, so there are no plans for this year. We're targeting the second half of next year, and will release once we're confident the content is genuinely enjoyable.

[b]Q. When is the next patch and update notes coming?[/b]
A. Barring special issues, we plan to patch this Thursday, with update notes released the same day. Weekly patches will continue this week and next to address convenience and bug fixes as much as possible.

[b]Q. Can you frequently add map expansions and new endgame modes?[/b]
A. Adding them frequently is realistically difficult. We expect to be able to show a new map expansion in the second half of next year.

[b]Q. Is it true the Sky Island (Floating Island) is free and coming in December?[/b]
A. We've never said that, and any rumors circulating are false. Nothing is decided yet. The Floating Island is introduced as a hook toward the end of the story, and we plan to keep it at an enjoyment stage for now. We'll share update details once the shape is clearer.

[b]Q. What kind of endgame content are you preparing?[/b]
A. We considered the Tower of Trials and Hunt Nightmare difficulty as endgame, but they're being consumed faster than expected. We're preparing additional endgame content to fill this gap.

[b]Q. Can you share your development priorities and timeline?[/b]
A. Our current priorities are stability, quality-of-life improvements, and bug fixes. New content preparation is happening in parallel but at a slower pace.

[b]Q. Will there be seasonal or limited-time events?[/b]
A. We're internally discussing event formats suitable for our package game. Nothing concrete yet, but we hope to bring something in the coming months.

[b]Q. Will Adventure Quest numbers continue past 60?[/b]
A. Yes, additional Adventure Quests are in development. The exact release timing depends on other content priorities.

[b]Q. Can we get a full roadmap document?[/b]
A. We shared a rough direction in this broadcast, and are considering releasing a written roadmap version soon so you can reference it anytime.

[b]Q. What's the frequency of new character additions?[/b]
A. We plan to add characters gradually rather than all at once. The next reveal timing hasn't been fixed yet.

[b]Q. Will there be balance patches after this one?[/b]
A. Yes, we plan to continue balance adjustments based on player feedback and gameplay data.

[b]Q. Are there any planned collaboration or crossover events?[/b] [b]✅[/b]
A. Nothing concrete at the moment. We're open to opportunities but nothing to announce yet.

[b]Q. When will the promised familiar improvements arrive?[/b]
A. We're targeting the next 2-3 patches to bring meaningful improvements to familiar mechanics.

[b]Q. Will you release patches on a fixed schedule?[/b]
A. Currently Thursday is our target patch day. This may shift for larger updates but we aim to be consistent.

[b]Q. Are there any large content updates before the console version?[/b]
A. Yes, we plan to deliver several content updates to PC before the console version, to establish a solid baseline.

[b]Q. Will hero balance patches happen regularly?[/b]
A. We plan regular balance passes based on data. Major hero reworks would be less frequent.

[b]Q. Can we get information on upcoming DLCs?[/b]
A. New DLCs are being planned but we're not ready to share specifics yet.

[b]Q. When will crossplay be considered?[/b]
A. Crossplay is a long-term consideration, not near-term. We'd need to solve various technical challenges first.

[b]Q. What's the plan for post-launch content pipeline?[/b]
A. We're building an internal pipeline for sustained content updates. The first meaningful new content is targeted for later this year.

[b]Q. Will there be any surprise announcements soon?[/b]
A. We can't share unannounced items, but we're preparing several things we hope will be well-received.

[b]Q. Are there plans to expand the Familiar system?[/b]
A. Yes, we plan to introduce new Familiars and expand their utility. Timeline is TBD.

[b]Q. Will hero side stories or personal quests expand?[/b]
A. We plan to add more Hero Quests and personal storylines gradually as part of the content pipeline.

[b]Q. When can we expect the next major story chapter?[/b]
A. The next major story arc will take significant time. We're targeting mid-to-late next year.

[b]Q. Will you add difficulty adjustments to existing content?[/b]
A. Yes, we're evaluating difficulty tuning for existing content, particularly Adventure Quests and dungeons.

[b]Q. Are you planning content specifically for veteran players?[/b]
A. Yes, this is on our radar. Endgame and challenge content updates are being planned.

[b]Q. Will there be Steam Workshop support in the future?[/b] [b]✅[/b]
A. Currently under review. Scope and timing to be shared once decisions are finalized.

[b]Q. Are there any planned QOL updates before the next content patch?[/b]
A. Yes, several QOL improvements are scheduled for the coming weekly patches.

[b]Q. What's the plan for controller-specific improvements?[/b]
A. We're actively addressing controller feedback. Several controller-specific fixes are being prepared.

[b]Q. Will there be player-created content support?[/b]
A. This is a longer-term consideration, tied to Steam Workshop discussions.

[b]Q. How often will you communicate with the community?[/b]
A. We're planning to broadcast every 1-2 months, with weekly patch notes and Discord updates in between.

[b]Q. Any teaser for future storyline direction?[/b]
A. The Floating Island and events surrounding the main antagonist are the next major beats. Specifics to come.

[b]Q. Will there be additional raid content beyond Ursula?[/b]
A. Yes, additional raid bosses are in development for release in the coming year.

[b]Q. Will we see a New Game+ mode?[/b]
A. It's an option we're evaluating internally. No firm decision yet.

[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h3]■ Combat & Controls[/h3][p]
[b]Q. Can you change the slower parts of the combat system?[/b]
A. Combat tempo is fundamental to the game's identity, so drastically changing the slower parts is realistically difficult.

[b]Q. A certain hero composition feels too strong — is a balance patch needed?[/b]
A. We believe the peak difference between team compositions isn't very large. Since bosses have different weaknesses and content can be cleared without specific comps, we're not planning short-term patches.

[b]Q. Can you improve targeting for ranged characters?[/b]
A. Yes, we identified issues with projectile aim and are patching some this week, with additional projectile improvements next week.

[b]Q. Will there be more combo variety for melee characters?[/b]
A. We're gradually adding combo options through skill adjustments and hero updates.

[b]Q. Can dodge and dash cancel be more intuitive?[/b]
A. We identified some issues with dodge-to-dash cancellation and fixed several. More improvements are being tested.

[b]Q. Is auto-target/lock-on being improved?[/b]
A. Yes, target lock-on improvements are being worked on and will roll out in stages.

[b]Q. Can you improve the switch (tag) system response time?[/b]
A. We're evaluating tag switch tempo. Some responsiveness improvements are being tested internally.

[b]Q. Will there be a training or practice mode?[/b]
A. A dedicated training mode is under consideration but not immediate priority.

[b]Q. Can you clarify the perfect dodge window?[/b]
A. Yes, we're planning UI feedback improvements to make the perfect dodge window clearer.

[b]Q. Some skills feel underused — will they be buffed?[/b]
A. We regularly review skill usage data. Underused skills are candidates for future balance adjustments.

[b]Q. Can we get more input options for skill activation?[/b]
A. We're evaluating additional input configurations, particularly for controller users.

[b]Q. Is the parry system going to be expanded?[/b]
A. Parry mechanics are considered fundamental. Expansion possibilities are being evaluated.

[b]Q. Will there be counterattack mechanics for all heroes?[/b]
A. Counterattack mechanics are being reviewed per-hero. Not all heroes will get identical mechanics.

[b]Q. Can you address animation cancels that break combat flow?[/b]
A. Yes, we identified several problematic cancels and are fixing them progressively.

[b]Q. Will jump attacks get more variety?[/b]
A. Aerial combat is being reviewed as a whole. Improvements will roll out gradually.

[b]Q. Can you reduce input lag on skill activation?[/b]
A. We're actively investigating input responsiveness. Improvements will be delivered when identified.

[b]Q. Will there be adjustments to signal skills?[/b]
A. Signal skills are core to combat identity. Adjustments happen carefully but are ongoing.

[b]Q. Can we get better visual feedback on hits?[/b]
A. Hit feedback is being reviewed. Some visual improvements are being tested.

[b]Q. Will difficulty scaling be adjusted?[/b]
A. Difficulty scaling adjustments are being evaluated based on player progression data.

[b]Q. Can we adjust camera behavior during combat?[/b]
A. Camera behavior improvements are ongoing. Several controller-specific issues are being addressed.

[b]Q. Will multi-hit skills be balanced?[/b]
A. Multi-hit skill balance is reviewed regularly. Adjustments made as needed.

[b]Q. Are there plans for defensive skill improvements?[/b]
A. Defensive mechanics are being reviewed for each hero individually.

[b]Q. Will there be different combat modes (e.g., aggressive/defensive)?[/b]
A. Alternative combat stance modes are not planned in the near term.

[b]Q. Can you add a combo counter display?[/b]
A. A combo counter UI is being considered but not confirmed.

[b]Q. Will there be improvements to boss combat pacing?[/b]
A. Yes, we're actively reviewing boss encounter pacing across the game.

[b]Q. Are stagger/stun mechanics being adjusted?[/b]
A. Stagger balance is being reviewed and will be adjusted based on data.

[b]Q. Can I customize skill button layouts?[/b]
A. Custom button layouts are being evaluated for future implementation.

[b]Q. Will there be a way to preview skill damage?[/b]
A. Skill damage preview is being considered but not confirmed.

[b]Q. Are boss patterns being made more readable?[/b]
A. Yes, we're reviewing boss telegraphs for readability improvements.

[b]Q. Will you add advanced combat tutorials?[/b]
A. Advanced combat guidance is being considered for future updates.

[b]Q. Can we get input display for training/streaming?[/b]
A. This feature is being considered for a future update.

[b]Q. Will there be adjustments to weapon block/parry timing?[/b]
A. Weapon-specific timing adjustments are reviewed per hero as needed.

[b]Q. Are there plans for character-specific ultimate visuals?[/b]
A. Ultimate visual enhancements are being considered on a per-hero basis.

[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h3]■ Characters[/h3][p]
[b]Q. Are there plans to add Ursula as a playable character?[/b]
A. There are no plans to make Ursula playable. She was designed as a boss and isn't suitable as a playable character.

[b]Q. Will there be a costume/skin for Ysera?[/b]
A. Ysera is one of the 6 story heroes, so there are no current skin plans. If demand is high we could consider it, but skins require redoing combat sounds and voice work, so it's difficult.

[b]Q. Will there be more character-specific costumes?[/b]
A. Yes, we plan to continue releasing costumes for various heroes. Selection is based on internal priority and character exposure.

[b]Q. Can we get a next character reveal preview?[/b]
A. We plan to reveal upcoming characters through broadcasts and community posts as they get closer to release.

[b]Q. Are there plans to add characters from other genres or archetypes?[/b]
A. We're aware of the desire for variety. New character archetypes are being planned but timelines vary.

[b]Q. Will side characters like Fio be added as familiars or NPCs?[/b]
A. Some side characters could appear in various roles. Nothing concrete yet.

[b]Q. Any plans to buff underused characters?[/b]
A. We regularly review character usage data. Underused characters are prioritized for balance adjustments.

[b]Q. Can a specific character get a rework?[/b]
A. Character reworks are considered case-by-case based on data and feedback.

[b]Q. Will there be more male playable heroes?[/b]
A. Yes, we plan to add more male heroes over time to keep the roster balanced.

[b]Q. Are you planning any character with unique gameplay mechanics?[/b]
A. Yes, upcoming characters are being designed with distinctive mechanics.

[b]Q. Will DLC characters ever be added, or all through gameplay?[/b]
A. All base heroes are obtainable through gameplay. Additional characters may come through updates.

[b]Q. Can we get color/appearance customization for characters?[/b]
A. Color palette customization for existing costumes is being considered.

[b]Q. Will there be voice options for characters?[/b]
A. Alternative voice options are not planned in the near term.

[b]Q. Are hero-specific quests getting expanded?[/b]
A. Yes, additional Hero Quests are planned. Timing depends on other priorities.

[b]Q. Can we get more character interactions during exploration?[/b]
A. Character interactions during exploration are being expanded gradually.

[b]Q. Will there be team synergy mechanics?[/b]
A. Team composition affects gameplay through skills and stats, but explicit team synergy bonuses aren't planned.

[b]Q. Are there plans for character emotes or gestures?[/b]
A. Emote features are being considered but not confirmed.

[b]Q. Can we get character-specific home/room customization?[/b]
A. Not planned in the near term.

[b]Q. Will there be story revealing characters' pasts?[/b]
A. Yes, more character backstory content is planned through Hero Quests.

[b]Q. Are all characters at the same power level?[/b]
A. We aim to keep characters roughly comparable in power, though playstyles differ.

[b]Q. Will there be limited-time character events?[/b]
A. We're considering various event formats. Character-focused events may come.

[b]Q. Can we play as villain characters?[/b]
A. Playing villain characters isn't planned in the main game.

[b]Q. Are there plans for guest characters from other IPs?[/b]
A. No guest character collaborations planned currently.

[b]Q. Will there be character growth systems beyond Awakening?[/b]
A. Additional growth systems are being considered.

[b]Q. Can we get character-specific lore books or codex expansions?[/b]
A. Codex content is being expanded gradually.

[b]Q. Are there plans for a duo/pair-based character system?[/b]
A. Some characters may have relationship-based mechanics, but no formal pair system planned.

[b]Q. Will Cerese's role in the story expand?[/b]
A. Yes, Cerese has significant upcoming story content.

[b]Q. Can we get more hero unlock quests?[/b]
A. Additional hero acquisition quests are being planned as new heroes are added.

[b]Q. Will there be a way to preview a character before unlocking?[/b]
A. Character preview options are being considered for the Codex.

[b]Q. Can we skip character intro dialogues?[/b]
A. A skip option is being considered.

[b]Q. Will Kalsion get expanded playable content?[/b]
A. Kalsion's Hero Quest and content will expand over time.

[b]Q. Are there plans for character-specific music themes?[/b]
A. Character themes exist for some heroes; expansion is being considered.

[b]Q. Can we get character-specific title cards or intros?[/b]
A. Some characters have distinctive intros. Expansion may come.

[b]Q. Will Roxy's aerial mechanics get more depth?[/b]
A. Yes, aerial mechanics improvements including for Roxy are being reviewed.

[b]Q. Are there any hidden or secret characters?[/b]
A. No hidden characters exist in the current game.

[b]Q. Will there be a character with healer/support focus?[/b]
A. Support-focused characters are being considered but nothing to announce.

[b]Q. Can characters swap their signature skills?[/b]
A. Skill swap is not planned as a mechanic.

[b]Q. Will there be more Familiars tied to characters?[/b]
A. Character-tied familiars are being considered.

[b]Q. Will Kalien get more content?[/b]
A. Yes, additional Kalien content is planned including Hero Quest expansions.

[b]Q. Are the Awakening tiers going to be expanded past 6?[/b]
A. The 6-tier Awakening system is designed as-is. Further expansion isn't planned near-term.

[b]Q. Can we get character-specific mount options?[/b]
A. Character-specific mounts aren't a core feature but may be considered.

[b]Q. Will there be crossover Familiars?[/b]
A. No crossover Familiars planned.

[b]Q. Are there plans for character weapon variety within a hero?[/b]
A. Character weapon variants are handled through weapon skins currently.

[b]Q. Can we get more Bond Quest content?[/b]
A. Yes, Bond Quests are being planned for expansion.

[b]Q. Will there be characters focused on stealth mechanics?[/b]
A. Charlotte's stealth is a distinctive mechanic. Additional stealth focus not planned near-term.

[b]Q. Are there plans for characters with transformation mechanics?[/b]
A. Transformation mechanics are being considered for specific future characters.

[b]Q. Will each hero get personalized endings?[/b] [b]✅[/b]
A. Personalized endings aren't planned. Story flows through the main character journey.

[b]Q. Can we choose favorite character to feature in menus?[/b]
A. Featured character selection is available in the Team menu.

[b]Q. Will there be character-specific challenge modes?[/b]
A. Character challenges are being considered for future updates.

[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h3]■ Items & Equipment[/h3][p]
[b]Q. Why is there no full-set effect when 2-set and 3-set effects exist?[/b]
A. We wanted players to freely combine equipment sets. If we created full-set effects, one meta build would be forced. To broaden choices, we designed 2-set and 3-set effects instead.

[b]Q. Can food (cooking/potion) cooldowns be reduced further?[/b]
A. Each dish has distinct cooldowns to preserve variety, so we don't plan to reduce further. When we tested with shorter cooldowns, players ended up just eating without moving — which we wanted to avoid.

[b]Q. Can we get more inventory sorting/filter options?[/b]
A. Yes, inventory management improvements are being planned.

[b]Q. Will there be an item auto-sell feature?[/b]
A. An item deletion feature is in development. Currently focused on Runes and cooking (including ingredients). We're avoiding making all items deletable to prevent accidents.

[b]Q. Can we increase the maximum stack size for items?[/b]
A. Stack size increases are being evaluated. Some rare items have limitations for game design reasons.

[b]Q. Will equipment upgrades and reforge get more transparent?[/b]
A. Yes, we're planning UI improvements to clarify upgrade and reforge outcomes.

[b]Q. Can we get an item favorite/lock feature?[/b]
A. An item lock feature is being considered.

[b]Q. Will there be more accessory slots?[/b]
A. Additional accessory slots aren't planned in the near term.

[b]Q. Can we exchange duplicate items?[/b] [b]✅[/b]
A. Item exchange systems are being considered for future updates.

[b]Q. Will there be item transmog (appearance change)?[/b]
A. Costume weapon skins are our current answer to this. Broader transmog is being considered.

[b]Q. Can we get bulk crafting/reforge?[/b]
A. Bulk crafting is being planned for future updates.

[b]Q. Will there be seasonal or limited-time items?[/b]
A. Seasonal items are being considered as part of event planning.

[b]Q. Can we increase gold/currency limits?[/b]
A. Currency limits are being evaluated. Rune inventory expansion (200→500) was recently done.

[b]Q. Will there be item preview before purchase?[/b]
A. Preview before purchase is being considered for the shop UI.

[b]Q. Can we get an item recovery/undo feature?[/b]
A. An item recovery feature has technical challenges but is being explored.

[b]Q. Will there be more variety in cooking recipes?[/b]
A. Yes, additional cooking recipes are planned.

[b]Q. Can we automate resource collection?[/b]
A. Automation isn't planned as it would undermine gathering gameplay.

[b]Q. Will there be equipment rerolling for specific stats?[/b]
A. Reroll systems are being considered as part of reforge improvements.

[b]Q. Can we get more storage space?[/b]
A. Storage expansion is being evaluated.

[b]Q. Will Rune synthesis get more diverse outputs?[/b]
A. Yes, we recently added 5-star Rune outcomes from 4-star synthesis.

[b]Q. Are there plans for legendary or unique equipment?[/b]
A. Unique equipment tiers are being considered for endgame content.

[b]Q. Can we get an equipment loadout save feature?[/b]
A. Loadout save/swap is being planned.

[b]Q. Will there be more variety in enchant options?[/b]
A. Enchant variety is being reviewed as part of ongoing balance work.

[b]Q. Can Runes be traded or gifted?[/b]
A. Trading is not planned for our single-player focused game.

[b]Q. Will there be item durability?[/b]
A. Durability isn't planned. We prefer players focus on progression.

[b]Q. Can we get item comparison in tooltip?[/b]
A. Item comparison is being considered as a UI improvement.

[b]Q. Will there be more currency types?[/b]
A. Additional currency types are added as needed for new systems, but we try to minimize.

[b]Q. Can we get materials from dismantling equipment?[/b]
A. Dismantle mechanics are being considered.

[b]Q. Will accessories get set effects?[/b]
A. Accessory set effects are being considered as part of equipment expansion.

[b]Q. Can Familiar-related items be expanded?[/b]
A. Familiar-related content expansion is planned.

[b]Q. Will there be item tier upgrades?[/b] [b]✅[/b]
A. Tier upgrade systems are being reviewed.

[b]Q. Can we mass-consume cooking items?[/b]
A. Bulk consumption is being considered for QOL updates.

[b]Q. Will there be more variety in weapon appearances?[/b]
A. Yes, weapon skins are being planned as ongoing content.

[b]Q. Can we get gathering location markers?[/b]
A. Gathering location display improvements are being considered.

[b]Q. Will Costume weapon skins be expanded?[/b]
A. Yes, weapon skins are being expanded alongside costume releases.

[b]Q. Can we craft food ingredients?[/b]
A. Ingredient crafting isn't planned currently.

[b]Q. Will there be item drop rate transparency?[/b]
A. Drop rate information is being added to the Options menu progressively.

[b]Q. Are there plans for item filters at the shop?[/b]
A. Shop filter improvements are being planned.

[b]Q. Can equipment be shared across characters?[/b]
A. Equipment is character-specific by design.

[b]Q. Will Familiar equipment be added?[/b]
A. Familiar-specific equipment isn't planned currently.

[b]Q. Are there plans for consumables beyond cooking?[/b]
A. Cooking is our primary consumable system. New consumable categories aren't planned.

[b]Q. Can we get materials from world bosses?[/b]
A. World Boss rewards are being expanded as of the recent patch.

[b]Q. Will there be seasonal cooking recipes?[/b]
A. Seasonal recipes are being considered as part of event planning.

[b]Q. Can old event items be re-obtainable?[/b]
A. Re-obtainable event items are being considered for future events.

[b]Q. Will there be more variety in Rune stats?[/b]
A. Rune variety is being reviewed.

[b]Q. Can items be sent to other characters?[/b]
A. Item transfer between characters isn't planned.

[b]Q. Will there be equipment-specific quests?[/b]
A. Some equipment is tied to quest rewards. Additional equipment quests may come.

[b]Q. Can we get a shortcut to reforge from inventory?[/b]
A. Reforge shortcut is being considered.

[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h3]■ Dungeons & Raids[/h3][p]
[b]Q. Isn't clearing platformer dungeons with specific characters like Reina unfair?[/b]
A. Originally, unlike gacha era, we wanted all characters to be usable. But when we improved jumping just before launch, characters with smaller stature became very difficult to clear platformer dungeons with.

[b]Q. The Ursula Raid is too long and boring — will it be adjusted?[/b] [b]✅[/b]
A. This week's patch will reduce Ursula's length to nearly half. Phases will be reduced to two — one humanoid battle, one dragon battle — and unnecessary wind-path sections will all be removed.

[b]Q. Will there be more raid bosses?[/b]
A. Yes, additional raid bosses are being planned.

[b]Q. Can dungeon clear rewards be improved?[/b]
A. Yes, dungeon and raid clear rewards are being increased 2-2.5x with this week's patch.

[b]Q. Will Tower of Trials get new floors?[/b]
A. Tower of Trials expansion is being planned as endgame content.

[b]Q. Are there plans for co-op dungeons?[/b] [b]✅[/b]
A. Multiplayer dungeons already exist. Expanding co-op-specific content is being considered.

[b]Q. Can we skip cutscenes on repeat dungeon runs?[/b]
A. Yes, cutscene skip improvements are being planned.

[b]Q. Will there be difficulty scaling for dungeons?[/b]
A. Difficulty scaling for existing dungeons is being reviewed.

[b]Q. Can we get random/roguelike dungeon modes?[/b]
A. Roguelike modes are being considered but not near-term.

[b]Q. Will hidden bosses be added to existing dungeons?[/b]
A. Hidden bosses are being considered as part of dungeon updates.

[b]Q. Are there plans for weekly raid rewards?[/b]
A. Weekly reward structures are being considered.

[b]Q. Can we get raid difficulty options?[/b]
A. Raid difficulty options are being considered.

[b]Q. Will there be more variety in dungeon objectives?[/b]
A. Objective variety is being reviewed for future dungeon design.

[b]Q. Can we get a dungeon leaderboard?[/b]
A. Leaderboard systems are being considered.

[b]Q. Will raid mechanics be documented in-game?[/b]
A. In-game raid guides are being considered.

[b]Q. Can we practice raid mechanics solo?[/b]
A. Solo raid practice modes are being considered.

[b]Q. Will there be seasonal raids?[/b]
A. Seasonal event raids are being considered for future events.

[b]Q. Can we skip already-cleared raid phases?[/b] [b]✅[/b]
A. Phase skipping isn't planned as it affects mechanics.

[b]Q. Will dungeon respawn timers be adjusted?[/b]
A. World Boss and Sudden Mission respawns were just adjusted to 2 hours.

[b]Q. Are there plans for open-world dungeons?[/b] [b]✅[/b]
A. Open-world exploration content is being expanded gradually.

[b]Q. Can dungeon party matchmaking be improved?[/b]
A. Multiplayer matchmaking improvements are ongoing including recent Quick Entry feature.

posts.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
posts.body:
[b]Hello, this is the DragonSword : Awakening team.[/b]

We've compiled answers to the questions most frequently asked by our players.

[hr][/hr]

[h3]■ Price & Purchase[/h3]

[b]Q. How much does the game cost?[/b]
The base price is $29.99 USD. Regional pricing follows Steam's purchasing power parity conversion. You can check the exact regional price on the store page.
🔗 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4570720/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/4570720/[/url]

[b]Q. Is this a gacha game?[/b]
There is no gacha. This is a Buy-to-Play (B2P) game — purchasing the game allows you to [b]obtain all 19 playable characters (at launch)[/b] through story progression.

[hr][/hr]

[h3]■ Platforms[/h3]

[b]Q. Is the game only available on Steam? Will it be on consoles (Nintendo, PlayStation)?[/b]
Currently, the game is only available on Steam. Console platform service is in preparation. Platforms and release timing have not yet been finalized, and we will announce details as soon as they are confirmed.

[b]Q. Is there a mobile version?[/b]
There is no mobile version. The game is currently available only on PC via Steam, with console platform service in preparation.

[hr][/hr]

[h3]■ How to Obtain DLC Items[/h3]

[b]Q. How do I obtain a familiar purchased as DLC?[/b]
Navigate to [b]Main Menu → Codex → Familiar → (Purchased Familiar)[/b] to obtain the item.

[b]Q. How do I obtain a costume purchased as DLC?[/b]
Navigate to [b]Main Menu → Heroes → (Character of Purchased Costume) → Costume[/b] to obtain the item.

[hr][/hr]

[h3]■ Gameplay[/h3]

[b]Q. In the tutorial, I can't get past the section where a tree is blocking the path.[/b]
Stand in front of the tree, press the [b]Interact button (Keyboard: F / Xbox Controller: Y)[/b], then move your character forward (Keyboard: W / Xbox Controller: Left Stick forward) to push the tree away.

[hr][/hr]

[h3]■ Relation to Previous Versions[/h3]

[b]Q. Is this Dragon Nest 2?[/b]
DragonSword : Awakening is a separate game from Dragon Nest. While some of our development team members previously worked on Dragon Nest, [b]DragonSword : Awakening is an entirely different IP and a completely separate game[/b].

[b]Q. Is this different from the previous versions (Webzen service, mobile)?[/b]
Yes, this is a different game from the previous service versions. Key changes include:
[list]
[*]Changed from a free-to-play model to a [b]Buy-to-Play (B2P)[/b] model
[*][b]Gacha system removed[/b] — all characters obtainable through gameplay
[*]Improved from mobile / keyboard-and-mouse focused controls to [b]full controller support[/b]
[*][b]Online functionality removed[/b] — converted to a single-player, package-style game
[*]Some character designs updated, with numerous refinements to detail and overall polish
[/list]

[b]Q. Does this game link with the previous service versions?[/b]
No, there is no data linkage with the previous service versions.

[hr][/hr]

[h3]■ Future Plans[/h3]

[b]Q. Will Steam Workshop be supported?[/b]
Steam Workshop support is currently under review. We will share details on the scope and timing once decisions are finalized.

[b]Q. Will the Sky Island (Floating Island) be a free update? If paid, how much will it cost?[/b]
Nothing has been finalized yet. We will announce details separately as they are confirmed.

[b]Q. I'd like to chat with other players in the town.[/b]
This feature is currently under planning and development review.

[hr][/hr]

If you have any additional questions, please reach out via the community or our official Discord.
🔗 [url=https://discord.gg/CzZ5ddkMVg]https://discord.gg/CzZ5ddkMVg[/url]

Thank you.

— The DragonSword : Awakening Team

posts.title: [Thank You] 300K Wishlists Reached — Messages From Our Dev Team
posts.body:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46066795/4af60a7fc3ef2da63298e75c2e6bc0d5f7e3414b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Hello, Heroes.[/b]
[b]This is the DragonSword : Awakening dev team at Hound13.[/b]

Thanks to the love we never expected, [b]DragonSword : Awakening's wishlist count has passed 300,000 before we knew it.[/b]

With less than two weeks until launch, our development team is now busy preparing for release.

To mark this 300K milestone, we've gathered greetings from members of our team who are hard at work on the ground, striving to deliver the most polished game we can. Not every developer was able to leave a message this time — but please remember that every single one of them holds the same heartfelt gratitude for your interest.

So that the meaning of each message can reach you as fully as possible, we've included the original Korean text alongside every translation.

Please keep cheering us on until launch.

[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h3]▸ hohehe[/h3][quote][p]
Thank you, truly, for all the love and interest you've shown us. To repay that love, we will do our very best to create a game that stays in your memory for a long time to come.

[b]— Original (Korean) —[/b]
보내주신 많은 사랑과 관심에 진심으로 감사드립니다.
그 사랑에 보답할 수 있도록, 여러분의 기억에 오래도록 남는 멋진 게임을 만들기 위해 최선을 다하겠습니다.
[/p][/quote][p]
[/p][h3]▸ Gwanguk Han[/h3][quote][p]
Thank you so much!

For us, these numbers aren't just statistics —
they feel like 300,000 hopes and 300,000 cheers.

We'll work even harder until launch,
and repay those 300,000 hopes with as close to zero excuses as we can possibly manage.
Thank you!

[b]— Original (Korean) —[/b]
정말 감사합니다!

숫자는 저희에게 단순한 통계가 아니라,
30만 번의 기대와 응원으로 느껴집니다.

출시까지 더욱 열심히 개발하여
30만 번의 기대에, 0에 가까운 핑계와 변명으로 보답하겠습니다.
감사합니다!
[/p][/quote][p]
[/p][h3]▸ EomDoyun · Programmer[/h3][quote][p]
I look at your messages of support every single day, and they give me strength. Thank you, always.

[b]— Original (Korean) —[/b]
여러분의 응원들, 매일매일 보며 힘을 얻고 있습니다. 항상 감사합니다.
[/p][/quote][p]
[/p][h3]▸ Dev Team Member 8[/h3][quote][p]
I hope the game we've prepared with all our sincerity is one you will enjoy.

[b]— Original (Korean) —[/b]
성의껏 준비한 게임이 마음에 드셨으면 좋겠습니다.
[/p][/quote][p]
[/p][h3]▸ MJ · Designer[/h3][quote][p]
300K — I can hardly believe it. Truly, sincerely, from the bottom of my heart, thank you 🙏
We poured so much love into making this game! I hope you have a wonderful time playing it 😍
See you on Steam on July 23~ 🙌🙌🙌

[b]— Original (Korean) —[/b]
30만이라니 믿기지가 않네요. 진짜 정말 진심으로 감사합니다 🙏
애정하는 마음 듬뿍 담아서 만들었습니다! 재밌게 즐겨주셨으면 좋겠습니다 😍
7/23일 스팀에서 만나요~ 🙌🙌🙌
[/p][/quote][p]
[/p][h3]▸ cartoonsong · Head Artist[/h3][quote][p]
Over the past few years with this team, we've been through many things. In every one of those moments, we've always given our all. Now — the final move, we leave to you.

[b]— Original (Korean) —[/b]
이 팀과 함께한 지난 몇 년 동안 많은 일이 있었습니다. 그 모든 순간마다 저희는 늘 최선을 다했습니다. 이제 마지막 한 수는 여러분께 맡기겠습니다.

[/p][h3]▸ Lee Wan · Action Programmer[/h3][quote][p]
Thank you for showing such great interest in our world. I hope that one day we may sit at a tavern in Orbis and watch over your adventures with a smile.

저희 세계에 많은 관심을 주셔서 감사합니다. 오르비스 주점에 앉아 여러분들의 모험을 웃으며 바라볼 수 있길 기원하겠습니다.
[/p][/quote][p]
[/p][h3]▸ Equinus · Lead System Designer[/h3][quote][p]
Thank you, and thank you again. We'll keep working even harder from here. We love you all.

감사하고 또 감사합니다. 앞으로도 더 노력하겠습니다. 여러분 사랑해요.

Thank you for the 300K wishlists.
If everyone on our wishlist ended up buying the game, nothing could make us more grateful (happy-daydream mode: fully engaged!) — but just having this much interest already means the world to us.

We ask for your continued interest and support in the updates we have planned, and we'll keep working to make a game that's worth buying.

Once again, from the bottom of our hearts — thank you.

위시리스트 30만 감사드립니다.
위시리스트의 모든 사람들이 구매해주신다면 그만큼 감사한 일은 없겠지만(행복회로 풀 가동!) 이미 이만큼 관심 가져주신다는 게 정말 감사할 따름입니다.

계획 예정인 업데이트에도 지속적인 관심과 응원 부탁드리며, 구매할 가치가 있는 게임을 만들 수 있도록 노력하겠습니다.

다시 한번 더 진심으로 감사드립니다.

Thank you so much for the love you've shown us. I was worried we might not get to show you World 2, which we've been working so hard on — but I'm truly happy and excited that this opportunity has come. We'll do our best so that we can share World 2 with you as well, someday. Please keep loving us in the days ahead!

많이 좋아해주셔서 감사합니다. 열심히 만들던 2월드를 보여드리지 못할까 봐 아쉬웠는데, 이렇게 기회가 생겨 기쁘고 기대됩니다. 언젠가 2월드도 꼭 공개할 수 있도록 열심히 하겠습니다. 앞으로도 많이 사랑해주세요!
[/p][/quote][p]
[/p][hr][/hr][p]
Ten voices — some brief, some long — each one carrying the heart of a person who has helped build DragonSword : Awakening over these years.

posts.title: Hero Introduction - [Dana] Hero Trailer
posts.body:
[b]Hello, this is Hound13.[/b]

We are unveiling the Hero Trailer for [b]Dana[/b] — one of the Heroes you will meet in the full game at launch.

Today's introduction features [b]Dana — the youngest of the Red Fox Mercenary Crew and a genius alchemist.[/b]

[previewyoutube=MQxqXZ2jGWo;full][/previewyoutube]

Dana wields the power of ice through her [b]magitech gun[/b] — the culmination of the arcane engineering she designed herself. Her signature combat style summons [b]Chako[/b], the ice golem she transmuted with her own hands, into battle at her side.

Once a researcher of Spirit Alchemy in Silvarantia, Dana lost the colors of the world in an unforeseen accident. posts.title: Post-Launch Roadmap & Q&A — Stream #4 Recap
posts.body:
[h1]🐉 Post-Launch Roadmap & Q&A — Stream #4 Recap[/h1][p]
Greetings, Mercenaries!

A heartfelt thank you to everyone who played our Steam Next Fest demo and shared their feedback. We are reading every comment carefully and actively checking what we can incorporate.

To express our gratitude, today we're sharing our [b]post-launch content plans for the second half of the year[/b], along with [b]answers to the questions[/b] you sent during the live stream.

[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h2]📺 Stream #4 VOD[/h2][p]For those who couldn't join us live, the [b]Stream #4 VOD[/b] will be uploaded shortly. [/p][p]You'll be able to review the roadmap and Q&A in video form, so keep an eye on our channel!
[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="ZT6o-5AuWP4;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h2]⚔️ New Hero Lineup (4 Heroes in H2)[/h2][p]We plan to roll out [b]4 new heroes[/b] over the second half of this year. [i](These 4 are included in the full version — not paid DLC — and will be developed regardless of sales.)[/i]

[b]🔹 Ryza — The First to Arrive[/b]
A shock-specialized character. She throws her spear, then teleports to its location to continue the assault, delivering fast, stylish combat.

The following three heroes will be released sequentially, with the order to be decided through internal discussion.

[b]🔹 Jerome — Knockdown Specialist[/b]
A small-statured character wielding a massive greatsword. Since the current lineup lacks a dedicated knockdown specialist, he's prioritized right after Ryza. He can unleash various skills upon Super Armor Destruction, and uniquely uses Grab up to three stages.

[b]🔹 Veronica — Bare-Handed Combat + Gun[/b]
Inspired by the many forum posts wishing for "a character who fights with fists." Stun is her primary attribute — she fires a gun at range and engages in martial arts up close, offering a fresh combat style.

[b]🔹 Logan — Tank Specialist[/b]
A tank-type character who attacks with a massive shield and protects allies. We plan to develop him into a more versatile character before his debut.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46066795/2c67d9c08cf7727da637d2b9cdacc36e8b0a4944.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h2]🛠️ H2 System Update Plans[/h2][p]
[b]Hero Quests (Story Content)[/b]
Quests exploring the untold stories of heroes not covered in the main story. We're preparing Othello's quest first, followed by one related to Ryza.

[b]Rift System[/b]
Rifts appear across the world, letting you travel to other dimensions for combat. We'll share more details as the system takes shape. [i](Contains slight spoilers!)[/i]

[b]Quality-of-Life Improvements (Top Priority)[/b]
This is what you requested most.
[/p][list][*][p]Combat feel · gamepad support · hit-feedback improvements
[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced "floaty" jump feel, instant sprint / auto-run
[/p][/*][*][p]Camera adjustments (free view, view distance, vertical/horizontal sensitivity, lock-on)
[/p][/*][*][p]UI hide / Photo Mode
[/p][/*][*][p]Help system
[/p][/*][/list][p]We're working to include these in the launch build wherever possible, and will continue reinforcing them after release.

[b]Balance Adjustments[/b]
In keeping with a premium package title, if any element consumes excessive time or causes inconvenience, we'll prioritize ongoing adjustments to economy and combat balance.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46066795/8aafb5a863a87859b6c773bbeeefef7978a09336.png"][/img]
[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h2]🎁 Editions & DLC[/h2][p]
[b]Standard Edition[/b]
The Standard Edition alone is more than enough to fully enjoy regular gameplay.

[b]Deluxe Edition[/b]
In addition to the Standard content, it includes:
[/p][list][*][p]A [b]Digital Artbook[/b] of game concept art (approx. 80 pages — regions, monsters, character art)
[/p][/*][*][p]A [b]Soundtrack[/b] collecting the game's music
[/p][/*][*][p]The Deluxe-exclusive Familiar 「Brave Baby Dragon」
[/p][/*][/list][p]Beyond 「Brave Baby Dragon」, a wide variety of Familiars can be obtained in-game, so feel free to choose based on your taste.

[b]Costume DLC (5 Costumes)[/b]
We've prepared costumes for Ornette, Cerese, Theresia, Dana, and Kalsion.
[/p][list][*][p]Each costume comes with a [b]dedicated weapon costume[/b].
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Toggle options[/b] for accessories such as eyepatches and headpieces are also included.
[/p][/*][*][p][i](Kalien's costume is hidden away in a secret in-game region — go find it after launch!)[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Coming in Post-Launch Updates[/b]
Additional costumes — including two swimsuit costumes for Reina and Astria — are in production and will be provided via post-launch updates.

[b]Familiars[/b]
There are roughly 30 Familiars in-game; about two-thirds are obtainable directly through play. The remaining third will be sold as DLC, but in-game acquisition alone is plenty to enjoy the game.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46066795/44976970599ae3eabd5d5eed617e21ca2f0916bc.png"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46066795/168ae92bcc93187584344bb98eadb5ce92baafe4.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46066795/444f54e1cfc181394eb4c603fc91a0526b6e8d94.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46066795/b6785dd7a88a53e01e1fece2655b785f547fd379.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h2]💬 Live Stream Q&A[/h2][p]For those who couldn't join the stream, we'll also be holding an [b]additional AMA[/b] soon — feel free to drop any new questions!

[b]Q. Are there plans for a console release?[/b]
Yes, we plan to prepare console versions after the Steam launch. However, which platform comes first has not yet been decided.

[b]Q. How long is the story playtime?[/b]
It varies by playstyle, but the main story runs roughly 10–15 hours. Adding Hero Quests and regional Bond Quests gives you a substantial amount of story content to enjoy.

[b]Q. Will Japanese voice-over be added?[/b]
We'd love to, but due to cost and time constraints we couldn't include it at launch. If results allow after release, we'd like to prepare it — though we can't make a firm commitment at this point.

[b]Q. Are there difficulty options?[/b]
A separate easy/core mode couldn't make it into this launch due to priorities. Instead, adventure difficulty rises automatically as you rank up, and you can manually lower it to play.

[b]Q. Are there microtransactions?[/b]
Aside from the Costume and Familiar DLC mentioned above, there are no separate in-game microtransactions.

[b]Q. What are the prices for the Standard and Deluxe Editions?[/b]
The Standard Edition is priced at [b]$29.99 (full price)[/b].
The Deluxe Edition has a [b]base price of $49.99[/b], and we are considering a launch discount for the Deluxe Edition only.
Prices in other regions follow [b]exchange rates and Steam's regional purchasing-power weighting[/b], as previously announced.

[b]Q. Will costume DLC be added for every character?[/b]
Nothing is finalized yet, but we have quite a few costumes prepared. After launch, we'll set up a separate costume roadmap and share progress following internal discussion.

[b]Q. Are there collaboration plans?[/b]
There are no collaborations planned at this time. We'd actively consider good opportunities, but since these can't be decided by us alone, they require careful review.

[b]Q. Can players talk, trade, or use shops with others in town?[/b]
Letting small groups explore towns and the world together is under long-term R&D consideration. However, player-to-player trading and shops are not currently planned.

[b]Q. Will there be an iaido (quick-draw) character?[/b]
A katana-wielding character is planned, but as far as we know, a true long-blade iaido playable character isn't currently scheduled. Ropie appears as an NPC who uses iaido, but there are no plans to make them playable yet. [i](We may provide a corrected answer at the additional AMA after checking internally.)[/i]

[b]Q. Are merchandise or comic books planned?[/b]
If the game does well and players grow fond of our characters, we'd certainly like to make merch. But we can't give a firm answer at this point.

[b]Q. Does the story conclude in the base game, or is a purchase needed later?[/b]
In the base game (Part 1), the mercenary crew's coming-of-age story reaches a conclusion. The untold story of Lute and the kingdom will be provided through future updates, though the format is still undecided.

[b]Q. How long does it take to develop a new character?[/b]
A completely new character takes at least about 8 months — concept art, combat concept, action design, polishing, modeling, sound, and voice work. That said, the 4 revealed heroes already have completed graphics work, and will be delivered after polishing tailored to the current version.

[b]Q. Why was the intro changed to hint at Lute's awakening?[/b]
We were concerned the slow early pacing around Lute could cause players to drop off, so we added staging that subtly hints at his later awakening. The opening was actually revised some 20–30 times — enough to fill a book! 😄

[b]Q. What's the difference between free and paid (DLC) Familiars?[/b]
There is no functional difference. Collecting more Familiars of the same species unlocks and strengthens abilities (e.g., jumping while climbing, reduced stamina cost), independent of whether they're free or paid. The main difference is appearance.

[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h2]📌 Additional Notes / Corrections[/h2][list][*][p][b]Access[/b] — The game runs only through Steam. As long as you're logged into Steam, you can play offline. [i](Correcting a point that was communicated differently before.)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]No Pre-Purchase[/b] — As our first release, pre-purchase functionality is restricted, so we're unable to offer it. Sales begin on the July 23 launch date.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Free Abyssal Direwolf[/b] — The 「Abyssal Direwolf」 Familiar, originally planned as a pre-purchase reward, can be obtained by everyone at a 100% discount (free) from launch through August 31. [i](Switching to paid from September.)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Character Acquisition Change[/b] — All 19 characters can be obtained through quests. (Either granted directly, or assembled using the 「Nameless Souls」 material.)
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Multiplayer for Hunt & Raid[/b] coming.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][hr][/hr][p]
We'll see you again soon at the additional AMA. Thank you for being with us.

[b]July 23, 2026 — See you on the continent of Orbis![/b] ⚔️🐉
[/p]

posts.title: To Everyone Who Played the Demo — Feedback Response & Full Release Update
posts.body:
[p]Thank you, sincerely, to everyone who played the DragonSword : Awakening demo and shared your valuable feedback with us.

[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h2]Addressing the Demo's Shortcomings[/h2][p]
We are fully aware that the current demo build hasn't yet reached the level you were hoping for. We recognize the lingering mobile-era design elements, the inconvenience of controller support, and the difficulty of combat with ranged characters due to the absence of a lock-on feature. Since the demo build was finalized, we've been rapidly developing improvements, and your demo feedback has already been incorporated into our development roadmap.

The following items, including those raised through your feedback, will be [b]addressed in the full release[/b]:

[/p][list][*][p]Lock-on feature
[/p][/*][*][p]Separation of dodge and sprint inputs
[/p][/*][*][p]Controller support and combat control improvements
[/p][/*][*][p]Mouse cursor visibility during cutscenes
[/p][/*][*][p]Cookbook filter feature
[/p][/*][*][p]Equipment enhancement menu improvements — including material quantity display
[/p][/*][*][p]Controller scroll support for in-game readables
[/p][/*][*][p]Combat targeting accuracy improvements
[/p][/*][*][p]Independent vertical/horizontal camera sensitivity options
[/p][/*][*][p]Map marker memo feature
[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial images
  [/p][/*][*][p]Controller D-Pad usability improvements
[/p][/*][*][p]R key (QWERTY) / T key (AZERTY) default rebinding
[/p][/*][/list][p]
We're also actively reviewing other feedback received. Suggestions such as camera mode and UI hiding will continue to be incorporated through post-launch updates.

[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h2]Language Support[/h2][p]
We're working to add more supported languages so players around the world can enjoy the game, and we plan to gradually improve translation quality as well.

[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h2]Business Model[/h2][p]
